name: Fix Club
tagline: We repair what we sell. The sandwich is not covered.
summary: Send in a broken product. The bench assesses it, quotes a price and repairs it. Repairs carry their own warranty.
concept: Things that can be repaired should be. We say honestly when something can't be.
who_its_for: Owners of an eligible product that has stopped doing what it was bought for.
price_list_note: Fixed repair prices live on each product's record, under its repair price list. We do not quote a repair price that is not on that list. If a fault is not on the list, the bench assesses it and sends a quote.
how_it_works: Request a repair with your order number or registration, and describe the fault.
Send the item in. In warranty, we send a free label both ways. Out of warranty, you pay to post it in.
The bench assesses it and sends a quote, valid for a fixed period.
Approve the quote and the repair goes ahead. Decline it and the item comes back.
The repaired item is sent back to you, with a repair warranty.

steps.title: Requested
steps.body: We have your request and your description of the fault.

steps.title: Awaiting item
steps.body: Waiting for the item to reach us. The label and postage instructions are in your confirmation.

steps.title: Received
steps.body: The item has arrived at our workshop and is booked in.

steps.title: Assessing
steps.body: The bench is looking at the fault. Out-of-warranty items carry an assessment fee, taken off the repair price if the repair goes ahead.

steps.title: Quote sent
steps.body: The quote is with you. It stays valid for a fixed number of days.

steps.title: Approved
steps.body: You have approved the quote. The item joins the repair queue.

steps.title: In repair
steps.body: The bench is working on it.

steps.title: Repaired
steps.body: The repair is complete and checked. The item is being packed.

steps.title: Returned
steps.body: The item has been sent back to you. The repair warranty starts now.

steps.title: Declined
steps.body: You declined the quote. The item is returned. The assessment fee still applies if the item was out of warranty.

steps.title: Unrepairable
steps.body: The bench cannot repair it. We say so plainly and send it back.

page.headline: We repair what we sell.
page.intro: We repair what we sell. The sandwich is not covered.

sections.title: What is covered
sections.body: Blip, Boombox Mini, The Daypack, The Indoor Helmet, The Starter Puddle, The Other Umbrella and The Trophy (re-plating, quoted).

sections.title: In warranty and out
sections.body: In warranty there is no assessment fee and we send a free label both ways. Out of warranty the £15 fee comes off the repair price if you go ahead, and you pay £4.95 to post it in.

sections.title: Prices and time
sections.body: Fixed prices are on each product's record. Anything else is quoted after assessment. Our target is 10 working days from the item arriving.

faq.a: Blip, Boombox Mini, The Daypack, The Indoor Helmet, The Starter Puddle, The Other Umbrella and The Trophy. The sandwich is not covered.

faq.q: How much does a repair cost?
faq.a: Each product has a fixed price list for common faults. Anything else is quoted after assessment. Trophy re-plating is always quoted.

faq.q: Is there a fee to have it assessed?
faq.a: Only out of warranty: £15, taken off the repair price if you go ahead.
In warranty, we send a free label both ways. Out of warranty you pay £4.95 to send it in; return postage is in the repair price.

faq.q: How long does a repair take?
faq.a: Our target is 10 working days. It is a target, not a promise.

faq.q: How long is a quote valid?

faq.a: Yes, for 90 days, against the fault that was repaired.

faq.q: What if it cannot be fixed?
faq.a: We say so and send it back. If it was in warranty, the normal returns rules apply.
